entities.name: UAC-0145
entities.gloss: A threat group tracked by CERT-UA associated with cyberattacks utilizing trojanized software distributions and DarkCrystal RAT.

entities.name: DarkCrystal RAT
entities.gloss: A commercial remote access trojan (RAT) offering extensive information stealing, remote surveillance, and execution capabilities.

entities.name: PinkyAgent
entities.gloss: A malware component designed to launch Python-based payloads such as the DWAgent remote access utility.

entities.name: DWAgent
entities.gloss: An open-source remote administration tool used for remote access and desktop management.

entities.name: Microsoft Office 2019
entities.gloss: A suite of productivity software developed by Microsoft.

entities.name: Python
entities.gloss: A high-level programming language and interpreter.

entities.name: KMSAuto
entities.gloss: A software utility used to activate Microsoft products without a valid license.

entities.name: toloka.to
entities.gloss: An internet domain hosting the Ukrainian BitTorrent tracker Toloka.

entities.name: hurtom.com
entities.gloss: An internet domain associated with the Ukrainian BitTorrent community portal.

entities.name: dwservice.net
entities.gloss: The official domain and online service infrastructure for the DWAgent remote administration platform.

entities.name: github.com
entities.gloss: A web-based platform for software version control and code hosting.
An IP address associated with network communication during the cyber incident.

entities.name: Microsoft.Office-x64.v2019.x.iso.torrent
entities.gloss: A BitTorrent file used to download a trojanized Microsoft Office ISO image.

entities.name: Microsoft.Office-x64.v2019.x.iso
entities.gloss: An ISO disk image containing trojanized installation files for Microsoft Office 2019.

entities.name: AUTORUN.exe
entities.gloss: An executable file embedded within the ISO image acting as a dropper for DarkCrystal RAT.

entities.name: Windows Update.exe
entities.gloss: An executable classified as PinkyAgent used to launch the DWAgent agent script.

entities.name: agent.py
entities.gloss: A modified Python script of the DWAgent remote access client.

relations.head: UAC-0145
relations.evidence: Описана активність відстежується за ідентифікатором UAC-0145.

relations.head: AUTORUN.exe
relations.evidence: Створюваний виконуваний файл є шкідливою програмою DarkCrystal RAT

relations.head: DarkCrystal RAT
relations.evidence: за допомогою DarkCrystal RAT на ЕОМ було завантажено ... файл "C:\ProgramData\service\core\Windows Update.exe"

relations.head: DarkCrystal RAT
relations.evidence: за допомогою DarkCrystal RAT на ЕОМ було завантажено ... вихідний код засобу віддаленого адміністрування DWAgent

relations.head: Windows Update.exe
relations.evidence: призначенням якого є запуск за допомогою Python-інтерпретатору скрипта "C:\ProgramData\service\core\agent.py"

relations.head: agent.py
relations.evidence: що, у свою чергу, здійснить запуск DWAgent
